segments.name: Protein degradation therapies
segments.description: A clinical-stage biotechnology segment developing PROTAC protein degrader therapies for patients with oncology and neurology diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations are organized into one operating and reportable segment focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of therapies that degrade disease-causing proteins.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue primarily from pharmaceutical partners through research collaborations and licensing arrangements, including upfront fees, research and development payments, milestones and royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: The operating segment's revenue is primarily generated through research collaborations and licensing arrangements with pharmaceutical partners.
